projects.title: Raspberry Pi and Particle Photon Communication
projects.description:
The main goal is to practice I2C, SPI, and Networking communication between a Raspberry Pi 3 and Particle Photon along with interrupts.
The secondary goal is a camera attached to the Raspberry Pi that will use OpenCV programming. The camera will track a red square and send information to the Photon with LEDs. the LEDs will be lighting in the same direction as the square.
The interrupt which is a button connected to the Raspberry Pi will shut down the camera and restart it.

projects.title: Gym Locker Count
projects.description: This idea is to try to make finding and reserving a gym locker easier for students through an app. The concept idea is to use the ability of the Photon microcontroller's wifi to communicate with a Raspberry Pi 3. the Raspberry Pi will act as a database where it can send information to the app and the Photon. A Nextion HMI LCD touch screen would be used to interface with the user to input their data to the Photon.
